name: @punchpress/desktop
description: The Electron desktop app for PunchPress.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:web && bun run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: dotenv -e ../../.env -- sh -c 'bun run scripts/ensure-electron.ts && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac'
scripts.build:unsigned: bun run scripts/ensure-electron.ts && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.notarize=false
scripts.publish: dotenv -e ../../.env -- sh -c 'bun run clean && bun run build:web && bun run scripts/ensure-electron.ts && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish always'
